summaryShort: This person makes you go for it. Around them, you are likely to feel more confident, more energized, and more willing to take a chance. They make big moves seem doable. What you would normally overthink, you may just do.
summaryDeep:
This person makes you go for it.

Around them, you are likely to feel more confident, more energized, and more willing to take a chance. They make big moves seem doable. What you would normally overthink, you may just do.

When this works, you build momentum fast. They believe in the possibility. You supply the action. Together, you can get a lot done because neither of you spends much time sitting on the sidelines.

The upside is obvious: you push each other forward. This is the person who talks you into applying, launching, asking, starting, or taking the leap.

The downside is just as obvious: you can talk each other into things that are not actually good ideas. Confidence is not a plan. Enthusiasm is not preparation. You may assume everything will work out because it feels exciting to believe it will.

This connection is strongest when you pair courage with common sense. Go for it. Just know what you are getting into first.
